comparison.objective: Saw moulding through at a marked 45-degree cut while holding it against a mitre-box fence.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual workpiece restraint, repeated tool strokes, regrasping, and cut alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Correct complete cut, with saw returned, moulding removed, and arms reset.
comparison.reason: This tests sustained sawing and workpiece restraint, not support-to-support sliding or rolling-element retention.
